summary: RE:Anima is a two-year Erasmus Mundus master's in animation. You spend the first semester at LUCA School of Arts in Genk, Belgium, the second at IADT in Dún Laoghaire, Dublin, and the third at Universidade Lusófona in Lisbon. Between 15 and 18 scholarships per intake cover tuition and pay €1,400 a month. Applications with a portfolio and showreel close on 27 January 2027.
meta_title: RE:Anima 2027: Erasmus Mundus animation master's scholarship
meta_description: RE:Anima covers tuition and pays €1,400 a month for a two-year animation master's in Genk, Dublin and Lisbon. Apply with a portfolio by 27 January 2027.
covers: The full tuition fee, which is €15,000 for the four semesters.
€1,400 a month during the programme, up to 24 months.
Between 15 and 18 scholarships per intake, out of at most 21 students.
eligibility: A bachelor's (EQF level 6) related to animation or film production. Graduates in other subjects qualify with relevant professional animation experience.

English at B2: IELTS 6.0, TOEFL iBT 79 or Duolingo 110. An English-taught degree exempts you only if it is from Australia, Canada (outside Quebec), the Caribbean, Ireland, New Zealand, South Africa, the UK or the US.
how_to_apply: Apply online through Universidade Lusófona's form by 27 January 2027 at 23:59 Western European Time.

Upload your passport, a recent head shot, your diplomas (with certified English translations), a CV of your animation experience, a motivation letter of up to 1,500 characters and your English certificate.

Add a portfolio PDF of up to 12 pages, a showreel of up to two minutes with English subtitles (an unlisted link with no password), and a project concept of up to 400 words with no more than two images.
watch_out: The portfolio and showreel decide most of the outcome, so start them now.
Living costs are put at €600 to €1,000 a month, which the allowance has to cover with travel and visas.
Self-funded students can look at the EU's Erasmus+ master loan guarantee.
documents: Passport or ID and a recent head shot
Portfolio PDF (12 pages) and showreel (2 minutes)

faq.q: Can I apply to RE:Anima without an animation degree?
faq.a: Yes, if you have relevant professional experience in animation.

faq.q: How many RE:Anima scholarships are there?
faq.a: Between 15 and 18 per intake; the number varies.
